description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_checkboxes} function, which generates HTML checkbox input elements based on provided parameters. It includes functions for rendering checkboxes with options, handling attributes, and outputting the HTML markup.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML checkbox inputs based on parameters such as options, values, checked items, and output formatting.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML markup for a single checkbox input, including label and checked state.
